claims.text: Comm "Coney Debrief": Manny Ortega does a debrief with Cindy McAllister after the events at Coney Island
Comm "Coping": Manny Ortega checks in with Cindy McAllister and offers some advice
Comm "Reassigned": Agent Alani Kelso asks Cindy McAllister to help her with the Black Tusk threat. Manny Ortega tells Kelso that Cindy has a new assignment
Comm "Wally": Manny Ortega introduces Cindy McAllister to Candace "Wally" Wallace
Comm "CINDY MCALLISTER: Nice to meet you, "Wally". Any special skills I should know about for job placement.": WALLY": Are you serious?
Comm "CINDY MCALLISTER: Yes.": WALLY": Okay, um, engineer, computers, helped run a nuclear power plant for the last six months. So, infrastructure and power.
Comm "CINDY MCALLISTER: How are you at puzzles?": WALLY": Great. Love them. The more impossible to solve the better.
Comm "CINDY MCALLISTER: I recovered this encrypted file from a Hunter drone, haven't been able to break the encryption, maybe you could take a stab at it.": WALLY": Oh, sure. Is that my job, now?
Comm "CINDY MCALLISTER: If you can crack the encryption.": WALLY": Sweet. I was a little worried you were gonna put me to work shucking corn or some bullshit.
Comm "CINDY MCALLISTER: You're an engineer. If you're going into food production I'd put you on the aquaponics system.": WALLY": You got a fish farm?
